title: The Frieza Saga in 5 Minutes (Dragonball Z Live Action)
original_title: The Frieza Saga in 5 Minutes (Dragonball Z Live Action)
overview: The Frieza Saga in 5 Minutes (Dragonball Z Live Action) (2015) In preparation for the U.S. release of Dragon Ball Z: Resurrection 'F' (2015), Mega64 reenacts the entire Frieza Saga of the anime Dragon Ball Z (1996) in sweded/homemade fashion under 5 minutes.
